reviews.feedback: 1) internal/api/team.go updateMember: the self-change check returns 403 before the last-owner check. Per the task, demoting the only owner is 409 last_owner 'also when the owner does it to themselves'. A sole owner PATCHing their own role to a non-owner role must get 409 last_owner; keep 403 when other owners exist. Fix the ordering (check last-owner first for the sole-owner self-demotion case), update the expectForbidden line in TestRoleChangesRules that uses e.Acme.Owner.ID with e.Acme.Key to expect 409 last_owner, and add a test that a non-sole owner changing their own role still gets 403. 2) internal/api/server.go authed: s.store.TouchAPIKey runs before the role check, so a refused request still mutates last-used time; the task says a refused request changes nothing. Move the TouchAPIKey call after the need(p.Role) check.
